The source critical equation and rank-one derivative yield the exact scalar parameterization, with invertible derivative -β/α. Exact formal inversion and substitution prove the fourth-moment cubic formula; the two-type sign polynomial and its two real zeros follow from rational algebra plus monotonicity. The k^-1/3 limit follows from the explicitly credited Hu--Sun uniform η_k→0 enumerator theorem. All 119 reproducible diagnostic checks pass; finite checks are not substituted for the theorem.

originality.rationale: The inspected Hu--Sun theorem leaves its analytic radius at quadratic order plus O(cubic), and does not identify the explicit rank-one fourth-moment cubic, the resulting signed moderate-tilt correction, or the exact reentrant sign pattern of positive two-type kernels. Its uniform enumeration theorem is acknowledged as the essential input; only the coefficient and classified sign are asserted as new. Searches and semantic index comparisons found no dominating theorem, but novelty remains provisional.
